text: Technology is part of our daily life now. Most people have a phone, a computer, or another device at home. In the morning, many people check their email or read a message from a friend before they even get out of bed. When you want to connect to the internet, your phone finds a wireless network, and then you can go online. People use apps for many things: to talk to friends, to watch a video, or to learn something new. Yesterday, my brother wanted to download a new app to help him study English. First, he had to type his password to open the app store. Then he clicked on the app and waited a few minutes. After that, he used his phone's camera to take a photo and upload it to the app. But then his phone battery was very low, so he had to charge it before he could keep using it. Technology can make life easier, but sometimes we forget to look up from our screen and talk to the people around us.
